Hi Maya — welcome, and congrats on the agreement. We’re ready to onboard Alder Labs. To create your vendor master we need the items below:

Required for US entities (standard):
- Completed W-9 (PDF)
- Bank letter or voided check showing account and routing (PDF)
- Legal business name + DBA if applicable
- Remit address (if different from business address)
- Primary PO contact name + email

Optional but helpful:
- Business license or incorporation docs
- AP hours / payment terms if special (net30 by default)

You can upload documents securely via our vendor portal: https://vendor.redwood.com/upload (temporary link attached) or reply to this thread with attachments. I’ve cc’d Marissa (legal) in case she needs to review entity naming, and I’ll loop in Finance for final PO routing.
